title: Add provider-auth injection seam for BYOK model calls
description: Review finding from loreweaver-den. Config validates anthropicApiKey, but AgentSdkModelClient relies on ambient process auth; hosted BYOK and alternate auth modes need explicit per-client or per-request secret injection without storage/logging. Related: loreweaver-qyj. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: AgentSdkModelClient can receive auth env/options explicitly or config key validation is removed; tests assert provider secrets do not enter traces, logs, campaign DBs, or tool payloads; docs clarify local and hosted BYOK auth flow.
close_reason: P2 review-findings batch (parent loreweaver-d4r); see PR.
